name: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server
description: Ancestry allele frequencies, LoF constraint, variant lists, and coverage from gnomAD, joined with ClinVar clinical significance via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

GNOMAD_DEFAULT_DATASET.title: Default dataset
GNOMAD_DEFAULT_DATASET.description: Optional default dataset: gnomad_r4, gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1, exac, or a subset (gnomad_r4_non_ukb; gnomad_r3_controls_and_biobanks, gnomad_r3_non_cancer, gnomad_r3_non_neuro, gnomad_r3_non_topmed, gnomad_r3_non_v2; gnomad_r2_1_controls, gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer, gnomad_r2_1_non_neuro, gnomad_r2_1_non_topmed).

GNOMAD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request timeout
GNOMAD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Optional per-attempt upstream timeout in milliseconds.

GNOMAD_MAX_VARIANT_BATCH.title: Variant batch limit
GNOMAD_MAX_VARIANT_BATCH.description: Optional maximum variant IDs per call.

NCBI_API_KEY.title: NCBI API key
NCBI_API_KEY.description: Optional NCBI key to raise the E-utilities rate limit.

GNOMAD_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable dataframe drop
GNOMAD_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Optional boolean enabling the dataframe drop tool.

GNOMAD_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp over-cap limits
GNOMAD_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Optional boolean (default true). false rejects a limit above its cap instead of clamping it with a notice.

GNOMAD_NORMALIZE_IDS.title: Normalize identifiers
GNOMAD_NORMALIZE_IDS.description: Optional boolean (default true). false rejects non-canonical ID spellings instead of rewriting them.
